content.query:
SELECT 
OTR.*
FROM OM.OM_TASKS OT 
	LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
		 ON OTR.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME
		 AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2024-08-12' AS DATE) 
		 AND (CASE WHEN OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2' THEN CAST('2025-07-09 08:47:12' AS DATETIME) else OTR.CREATE_DATETIME END) >= CAST('2025-07-09 08:47:12' AS DATETIME)
	LEFT JOIN OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL OCAD
		 ON OT.TASK_NAME = OCAD.TASK_NAME
		 AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2024-08-12' AS DATE) 
		 AND OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME >= CAST('2025-07-09 08:47:12' AS DATETIME)
	LEFT JOIN OM.OM_STATUS OS
		 ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID
	LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL OTED
			ON OTED.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME
			AND OTED.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2024-08-12' AS DATE)
			AND OTED.CREATE_DATETIME >= CAST('2025-07-09 08:47:12' AS DATETIME)

	WHERE  OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'DEP'
		AND OT.DATA_LAYER LIKE '%EDS%'
		AND coalesce(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = 1
